content.text: In Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan, the inability to use [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-honest-side-side-breakdown-8|COREMERCH guide to stripe]], Teachable, or Gumroad forces digital sellers to navigate a complex web of platform restrictions, leaving them without a reliable [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-selling-design-assets-crypto-payments|infrastructure]] to sell their courses and digital products. This situation is not unique to these countries, as over 130 nations face limitations when trying to use popular payment gateways like Stripe, PayPal, and Lemon Squeezy. The lack of infrastructure [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-which-architecture-actually-5|Sovereign Commerce]]ty, where creators are beholden to the whims of third-party platforms, is a significant obstacle to growth and entrepreneurship. The good news is that there is a permanent structural alternative at the base layer, built specifically for creators in restricted countries, that provides a solution to this problem.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Courses teachable

At its core, this infrastructure solution is a sovereign commerce stack, a combination of free and paid tools that empower digital creators to establish their own online stores, manage payments, and retain full control over their data. Unlike traditional e-commerce platforms, which often require creators to relinquish control and abide by restrictive terms of service, this stack is designed to be flexible, customizable, and decentralized, allowing creators to build a robust online presence without relying on third-party platforms.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The underlying architecture of this commerce stack leverages open-source technologies like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, and Cloudflare Workers to provide a scalable and secure hosting environment. Supabase and Google Sheets are used for order storage and inventory management, while Google Drive and Cloudflare R2 enable seamless file delivery to customers. NOWPayments, a cryptocurrency payment processing service, handles on-chain transactions, ensuring that creators can receive payments in their preferred currency without incurring significant fees or undergoing lengthy verification processes.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This sovereign commerce stack is specifically designed for digital creators operating in countries where major payment gateways like Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad are unavailable or severely restricted. By providing a base-layer infrastructure solution, COREMERCH aims to empower creators in these regions to build a sustainable online presence, expand their customer base, and grow their businesses without the burden of platform dependencies.
This sovereign commerce stack is not a workaround or a hack, but a permanent structural alternative at the base layer that empowers creators to build a sustainable online presence.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a comprehensive solution that includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours. This stack supports up to five products, configures SPF, DKIM, and DMARC, and undergoes end-to-end testing before handoff. Additionally, the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) offer more flexible and customizable options for creators who prefer a DIY approach.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, creators can visit the COREMERCH product page at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html and select the Edge Commerce Stack or another suitable solution. Once the stack is deployed, creators can upload their digital products, set up payment processing, and start selling to their customers. With its user-friendly interface and robust features, this sovereign commerce stack makes it easy for creators to establish a professional online presence and start growing their businesses today.
